intro.text: Animashree (Anima) Anandkumar is the Bren Professor of Computing at California Institute of Technology. She is also the co-founder of Accelerated Understanding. Previously, she was a senior director of Machine Learning research at NVIDIA and a principal scientist at Amazon Web Services. Her research considers tensor-algebraic methods, deep learning and non-convex problems.
